title: Two-qubit charger-battery system subject to weak, continuous measurements with quantum point contacts
summary: Quantum batteries modeled as two-qubit systems coupled to Markovian thermal reservoirs have been shown to benefit from measurement-assisted charging, where projective measurements enhance the charging rate at an infinite thermodynamic resource cost. In this work, we consider weak, continuous measurements implemented via quantum point contact detectors (QPC), which enhance the charging rate at a definite and quantifiable resource cost.
